_comment: Every external host named in a shipped file (pages, scripts, styles, functions, headers). Kept in step with docs/PRIVACY_TECHNICAL_INVENTORY.md by tests/third-party-hosts.test.mjs. 'kind': first-party | runtime-on-demand (browser contacts it after a user action) | runtime-always (browser contacts it on page load) | server-side (only our functions contact it) | link (outbound link the user may click) | reference (namespace or comment, never fetched) | csp-allowance (allowed by the Content-Security-Policy but nothing in the shipped files loads from it) | disabled (named in config but switched off). 'openAllowances' lists scheme-only CSP sources (for example img-src https:) that let the browser contact hosts this file cannot enumerate; tests/third-party-hosts.test.mjs fails when the CSP gains or loses one.

hosts.note: Supabase project (auth, database, realtime), region eu-west-1 (Ireland). Contacted for sessions and cloud sync of signed-in users.
Paddle checkout script, loaded only when the player opens the TITAN+ checkout (js/main.js).
Assistance e-mail delivery from functions/assistance.mjs only.
Community link in js/config.js; the player leaves the site by clicking.
Adcash script URL in js/config.js; adsEnabled is false and the host is not in the CSP script-src, so nothing loads.
Licence credit in a CSS comment.
Licence credit in a CSS comment.

Allowed by the CSP for connect-src, frame-src and form-action: the checkout overlay and its API calls (for example buy.paddle.com, checkout-service.paddle.com). Hosts contacted by paddle.js itself cannot be enumerated from this repository. The TITAN account id is passed to Paddle as customData.user_id.

openAllowances.note: Any HTTPS image can load. Used by content-driven images (cover_image_url of dynamic pages, mobs/bosses/creatures image_url from the database): the image host sees the visitor's IP and referrer. Tightening needs the content tables to be audited first.
